'''Senate Day''' was a celebration held in the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It honored [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]] and unity and was celebrated with [[Fireworks/Legends|fireworks]]. At least one Senate Day was held<ref name="Senatorial" /> in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Senatorial Celebration|Coruscant}}</ref>

==History==
During at least one Senate Day during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]<ref name="Date" />, fires broke out across the Senate Plaza, which caused several pruning [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to panic. Ultimately, the droids were calmed and the fires were extinguished.<ref name="Lawn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Lawn and Order|Coruscant}}</ref> After the celebration, maitenance droids were hijacked and used to vandalize the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] with [[Graffiti/Legends|graffiti]].<ref name="Vandals">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Vandals at the Gate|Coruscant}}</ref>
